High Protein Cheesy Chicken Alfredo Rolls🍗🧀🌯 65g Protein Meal Prep💪🏼 (Macros: Per Roll - 10 Total) 438 Calories 25gC | 13gF | 65gP Want more recipes like this? check out my high protein cook books with over 300 recipes 👨🏻‍🍳📚 Ingredients:  1.7KG Boneless & Skinless Chicken Breast (raw weight) 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika, 1 Tsp Onion Powder, 1 Tsp Garlic Powder, 1 Tsp Salt 1 Tsp Olive Oil 1 Large Diced Brown Onion 4 Diced Garlic Cloves 450g Low Fat Cottage Cheese 35g Grated Parmesan Cheese 100ml Low Fat Milk 2 Tsp Italian Herb Seasoning, 1/2 Tsp Black Pepper, 1/2 Tsp Salt 60g Light Cream Cheese 10 Warm Tortillas (Mission Carb Balance Tortillas) 40g Light Mozzarella (per roll - 10 total) Egg Wash or Light Cooking Oil Spray Topping: Grated Parmesan Cheese & Parsley Flakes Instructions: 1. Slice chicken into fillets. Season with paprika, onion powder, garlic powder & salt, drizzle with olive oil and mix. 2. Cook in a pan over medium-high heat for approximately 4 mins per side or until cooked through. Set aside and dice. 3. Cook onion in the chicken juices until softened. Add garlic and diced chicken, mix well, then turn off the heat. 4. Blend cottage cheese, parmesan, milk, Italian herbs, salt & cream cheese until smooth. 5. With the heat completely off, add the sauce, mozzarella & parsley to the pan and mix well. 6. Add 1/10th of the filling to each warm tortilla, add mozzarella, then roll tightly. 7. Place on a lined baking tray. Brush with egg wash or spray with oil, then top with parmesan & parsley flakes. 8. Bake at 190°C/375°F for 8 – 12 mins or until golden brown & crispy. #chicken #alfredo #highprotein #healthyrecipes #mealprep

Crispy Honey Garlic Chicken Fried Rice🍗🍯🍚 One of the best sheet pan recipes, so simple and delicious - Minimal effort, a game changing way to meal prep for the week! Macros Per Serving (8 Total) 550 Calories | 42g Protein | 52g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 8 Servings) Honey Garlic Chicken - 1300g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, cubed and fat trimmed - 2.5 Tsp Black Pepper - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 6 Tsp Olive Oil - 50g Honey - 30g Light Soy Sauce  - 25g Dark Soy Sauce Creamy Sriracha Sauce - 300g Low Fat Yogurt  - 120g Light Mayo - 50g Sriracha - 25g Honey - 1.5 Tsp Smoked Paprika Toasted Sesame Fried Rice - 450-500g Frozen Mixed Vegetables (i had carrots, sweetcorn, green beans, peas) - 100g Green Onion, white part - 40g Sesame Seeds - 350-400g Uncooked White Rice (700-800g Cooked) - 40g Light Soy Sauce (adjust based on color) - 50g Green Onion, green part - 20g Light Butter, gives silky smooth texture to rice 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Slice chicken thighs into small cubes, trim excess fat, add seasoning with olive oil, honey and soy sauce. Mix well, set aside 2. In a bowl, add yogurt, mayo, sriracha, honey and smoked paprika. Mix till smooth. Bottle and refrigerate for the week 3. In a large lined sheet pan, spread marinated chicken, add cooking spray then oven bake for 20 mins at 190C / 390F until golden brown & crispy 4. Once chicken is cooked, remove from pan leaving resting juices. Add mixed veggies, green onion and sesame seeds. Mix thoroughly in all the chicken juices. Spread flat and oven roast for 15 mins 5. Once cooked, add leftover rice, soy sauce, green onion and light butter. Mix gently till coated and fluffy. Add chicken, mix well then serve with creamy sauce & ENJOY! . . . . #friedrice #honeygarlic #sheetpan #mealprep #healthyrecipes

Creamy lemon chicken makes a quick easy and delicious dinner perfect for those busy nights. 1 tsp salt 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/4 tsp pepper  1/4 tsp paprika 1/2 tsp Italian seasoning  2 pounds boneless skinless chicken breast 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour  1/2 cup shredded Parm 4 cloves crushed garlic 2 tbs freshly squeezed lemon juice  1 tbs lemon zest 1 tbs olive oil 4 tbs butter 1 cup heavy whipping cream  1 cup water For the sauce: I/2 tsp salt 1/4 tsp salt Season chicken breast with seasoning on both sides then brown in a pan over high heat in olive oil. Remove the chicken from the pan. In the same pan, add butter and one melted, add garlic. Sauté for a minute and then add in flour and sauté an additional minute. Add in water, lemon juice, and heavy cream. Once the sauce comes together, add in lemon zest, Parmesan cheese and salt and pepper. Stir until the cheese is fully melted then add the chicken back to the pan. Cover with the lid and simmer for five minutes. Spoon the sauce over the chicken. Top with chopped parsley and sliced lemon. . . . #lemonchicken #easyrecipes #dinnerideas #chickenrecipe #quickrecipe

Before cooking chicken take out the fridge to allow it to get to room temperature. In a pan add oil and brown chicken on both sides then remove chicken.  Add your onion and bell peppers to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes before adding garlic.  Add your sofrito, tomatoes sauce, seasonings and olive mixtung together. Allow to simmer until fragrant.  Add your chicken back to the pot with water enough to cover the chicken. Add the potatoes and your bay leaves and let cook for 20 minutes until your potatoes are fork tender. You have to save this and make these immediately!  MINI APPLE PIES  Recipe and Inspo by: @Robyn Q  These were simple and amazing!  Ingredients:  ⁃ Cooking spray  ⁃ 1 Puff Pastry   ⁃ 1 can apple pie filling  ⁃ 8 ounces whipped cream cheese  ⁃ 1/4 cup cinnamon sugar   ⁃ 1 egg, for an egg wash  Directions:  1. Grease the inside of one muffin tin and the outside of another.   2. Lay the puff pastry on top of the muffin tin that is sprayed on the inside. Use the other muffin tin to press on top of the dough to make wells. Sprinkle the wells with some cinnamon sugar.   3. Add some cinnamon sugar to the  whipped cream cheese to taste and mix. Add a small scoop of the cinnamon sugar cream cheese inside the wells of the puff pastry. Top with a scoop of the apple pie filling.   4. Use a pizza cutter to cut into separate pieces. Then pull the corners of each towards the center and press to seal in the middle.  5. Brush with the egg wash and sprinkle with some cinnamon sugar.  6. Place in a 400 degree oven and bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.  #groarkboysbbq #themeatteacher #baking

Garlic Butter Beef Linguine with Creamy Parmesan Cheddar Sauce 🥩🧄🧀🍝 This Garlic Butter Beef Linguine is creamy, cheesy, and packed with rich garlic butter flavor. Tender seasoned ground beef is tossed with linguine in a silky Parmesan cheddar sauce for an easy, comforting dinner everyone will love. Ingredients * 12 oz linguine * 1 lb lean ground beef * 1 tbsp olive oil * 3 tbsp butter * 4 cloves garlic, minced * 1 cup heavy cream * 1/2 cup beef broth * 1 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese * 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese * 1 tsp Italian seasoning * 1/2 tsp crushed red pepper flakes (optional) * 1/2 tsp garlic powder * Salt and black pepper, to taste * 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley Instructions 1. Cook the linguine according to the package directions until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup of the pasta water, then drain. 2. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it apart as it cooks. Drain excess grease if needed. 3. Add the butter and minced garlic. Cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. 4. Pour in the beef broth and heavy cream. Stir well and simmer for 3–4 minutes. 5. Add the cheddar cheese and Parmesan cheese, stirring until completely melted and smooth. 6. Season with Italian seasoning, garlic powder, crushed red pepper flakes, salt, and black pepper. 7. Add the cooked linguine to the skillet and toss until every strand is coated in the creamy sauce. Add a splash of reserved pasta water if needed. 8. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve immediately. Serving Suggestions Serve with garlic bread, Caesar salad, roasted broccoli, or sautéed green beans. Storage Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. Reheat gently with a splash of milk or cream. Time * Prep Time: 10 minutes * Cook Time: 20 minutes * Total Time: 30 minutes Servings: 4–6 Save this recipe and follow for more easy comfort food recipes! ❤️ #GarlicButterBeef #CreamyPasta #Linguine #GroundBeefRecipes #EasyDinner

Artist Casey Curran creates kinetic sculptures that combine mechanical systems with forms inspired by plants and natural structures. In this prototype, layers of delicate petals are connected so that a single mechanical action produces a rippling movement across the entire structure. Instead of every element moving independently, the motion travels through the sculpture like a wave. This type of movement is central to Curran’s practice. Using motors, wires, cranks and carefully engineered mechanisms, he creates artificial flowers and organisms that bloom, flutter and contract.  The machinery is artificial, but the movement feels strangely organic ,engineering becomes a way of imitating the rhythms of living systems. #art #artist #fashion #avantgarde #design

Nashville Hot Mozzarella Sticks RECIPE ⬇️ These Nashville Hot Mozzarella Sticks are extra crispy on the outside, loaded with stretchy, melted cheese, and coated in a spicy Nashville hot oil. They’re the perfect combination of crunchy, cheesy, spicy, and ridiculously addictive! INGREDIENTS Mozzarella Sticks 1 lb block mozzarella cheese 1 cup all-purpose flour 2 eggs, whisked 1–1½ cups Italian seasoned breadcrumbs Breading Seasoning ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1 tsp paprika ½ tsp cayenne pepper Nashville Hot Oil ½ cup hot frying oil 1 tbsp cayenne pepper 1 tsp brown sugar ½ tsp smoked paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Pinch of salt For Frying Vegetable or peanut oil DIRECTIONS Cut mozzarella into thick sticks, about ¾–1 inch thick. Set up three bowls with flour, whisked eggs, and breadcrumbs mixed with all the breading seasonings. Coat each stick in flour, egg, breadcrumbs, then egg and breadcrumbs again for a thick, crispy coating. Make sure the cheese is completely covered. Freeze for 45–60 minutes until very firm. Heat frying oil to 350°F. Fry in batches for approximately 1½–2 minutes until golden and crispy. Remove and drain on a wire rack. Combine Nashville hot seasonings in a bowl. Carefully whisk in ½ cup hot frying oil, slightly cooled, until combined. Brush the Nashville hot oil over the crispy mozzarella sticks until fully coated. Let rest for 30–60 seconds, then serve while hot for the ultimate cheese pull! #nashvillehotchicken #cheese #recipe #cooking #lunch

If you need an easy dinner idea tonight, make these sheet pan chicken fajitas.  One of the easiest dinners ever, so flavorful, so delicious, and dinner is on the table in about 30 minutes. Everyone loved it. Ingredients: •4 medium chicken breasts sliced into thin strips (or boneless skinless chicken thighs) •1 large onion sliced •1 green pepper sliced •1 red pepper sliced •1 yellow pepper sliced •¼–⅓ cup olive oil or avocado oil •2–3 tsp salt •1 tsp black pepper •1 tbsp paprika •2 tsp cumin powder •2 tsp garlic powder Homemade Guacamole: •3 ripe avocados •½ onion finely chopped •1 Serrano chili (optional) •½ bunch cilantro chopped •Juice from 2 limes •Salt to taste •Tortillas of choice Instructions: Slice the chicken into thin strips and add directly onto a sheet pan. I skipped parchment paper because I wanted the chicken and vegetables to get direct heat from the pan for extra flavor and color. Slice the onion and peppers into strips and add them to the pan. Season with all the spices, drizzle with oil, and toss everything together really well. Spread into an even layer and bake in a preheated 425°F oven for 20–25 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare the guacamole. Mash the avocados and mix with the onion, Serrano chili, cilantro, lime juice, and salt. Give the chicken and vegetables a quick toss, then broil for another 2–3 minutes until slightly charred. Serve in warm tortillas with fresh guacamole, cilantro, and an extra squeeze of lime. #sivanskitchen #sheetpan #fajita #chicken #easyrecipe

Garlic Herb Grilled Chicken Bowl🍗🧄🍚🥗 Juicy Middle Eastern grilled chicken served with fluffy spicy rice, refreshing tabbouleh, and a smooth, spicy garlic cream sauce. Every bite is loaded with flavour🤌🏽 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 650 Calories | 52g Protein | 59g Carbs | 22g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6) Middle Eastern Chicken - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Paprika - 3 Tsp Cumin - 30g Honey - 80-100g Tomato Paste  - 1 Lemon Juice  - 30g Olive Oil Golden Herb Rice - 300g Uncooked Basmati Rice (Cook this beforehand) - 20g Light Butter - 100g White Onion, finely chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1.5 Tsp Turmeric - 1 Tsp Paprika - 1 Tsp Cumin Tabouleh Salad - 3 Cups Parsley, chopped - 300g Tomato, chopped and de-seeded - 150g Green Onion/Scallion, chopped - 15g Olive Oil - Lemon Juice - 1/2 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Sumac - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes Spicy Garlic Sauce - 300g Low Fat Yogurt - 100g Light Mayo - 120g Chilli Garlic Sauce (Lee Kum Kee) - 1 Tsp Paprika  - 1 Tsp Onion Powder - 1/4 Cup Evaporated Milk 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add the Middle Eastern spice mix, honey, tomato paste, lemon juice and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a pan over low heat. Add light butter and chopped onion, cook for 5 mins until softened. Stir in the seasoning and toast for 3-4 mins . Add cooked basmati rice, turn off the heat and mix until fluffy and golden. 3. In a bowl, combine chopped tomato, green onion, parsley, olive oil, seasoning and lemon juice. Mix well and refrigerate until ready to serve. 4. Spread the chicken on a lined sheet pan and oven bake at 200C / 400F for 20-25 mins, then broil/grill for 5 mins until golden and juicy. 5. While the chicken rests, whisk together yogurt, light mayo, chilli garlic sauce, seasonings and evaporated milk until smooth. 6. Serve with the spiced rice, fresh salad and garlic sauce. Making Cajun Shrimp & Sausage pasta in my room! 🦐🤤 — I would make this everyday if I could. Pretty much a one pot meal! What should I make for Halloween? 👀  Order Lazy Pot on Amazon! Ingredients: * Cajun sausage * Medium shrimp, peeled and deveined, tails removed * Salt * Black pepper * Onion powder * Garlic powder * Cayenne pepper * Paprika * Red pepper flakes * Parmesan cheese * Heavy cream * Butter * Rigatoni or pasta of choice * Fresh parsley * Sliced baguette Instructions: * Season shrimp and sliced Cajun sausage with salt, pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, cayenne, paprika, and red pepper flakes. * Melt butter in a large pan and cook sausage until browned. Add shrimp and cook until pink and opaque. Remove both and set aside. * Boil pasta in salted water until al dente. Meanwhile, toast baguette slices in butter until golden and crispy. * In the same pan used for the shrimp and sausage, melt additional butter and pour in heavy cream. Stir over medium-low heat to create a smooth sauce. * Gradually add grated Parmesan cheese, stirring until melted and thickened. Add additional seasonings to taste. * Add cooked pasta and toss until evenly coated in the creamy Cajun sauce. Add a splash of pasta water if needed. * Return the cooked shrimp and sausage to the sauce, reserving a few pieces for plating. Mix well. * Plate the pasta and top with reserved shrimp and sausage. Finish with freshly chopped parsley for color. * Serve with toasted buttered baguette slices on the side for dipping into the sauce!  #food #pasta #easyrecipe #cooking #dinnerideas

Creamy Cajun Chicken & Rice✨🌶️🍗 #dinnerideas #easyrecipes #quickdinner #weeknightmeals #onepanmeal  Recipe: * 6–8 boneless, skinless chicken thighs * Avocado oil * Cajun seasoning * Paprika * Onion powder * 1 packet sazon * Garlic powder * Salt, to taste * Black pepper, to taste * 1 tbsp butter * 1 diced onion * 4 cloves garlic, minced * 1 red bell pepper, diced * 1 orange bell pepper, diced * Cooked white rice * Fresh parsley, for topping Creamy Cajun Garlic Sauce * 2 tbsp butter * 2–3 cloves garlic, minced * Paprika, to taste * Cajun seasoning, to taste *Italian seasoning  * 1 cup heavy cream Instructions 1. Season the chicken:     Add the chicken thighs to a large bowl. Drizzle with avocado oil and season with Cajun seasoning, paprika, sazon, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Mix well until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Cook the chicken:     Heat a large pan over medium-high heat and add a little avocado oil or butter. Sear the chicken thighs on both sides until golden brown and cooked through, reaching an internal temperature of 165°F. Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside. 3. Cook the vegetables:     In the same pan, add 1 tablespoon of butter. Add the diced onion and minced garlic and sauté until fragrant. Add the diced red and orange bell peppers and cook for a few minutes until softened. Season with a little more Cajun seasoning. 4. Add the rice:     Once the vegetables are softened and slightly browned, add your cooked white rice to the pan. Mix everything together well so the rice is coated with all those Cajun flavors. 5. Add the chicken:     Place the cooked chicken thighs on top of the rice and vegetables. 6. Make the creamy Cajun sauce:     In a small saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds, until fragrant. Add paprika and Cajun seasoning, italian seasoning and stir to combine. Pour in 1 cup of heavy cream and bring it to a gentle simmer. Continue stirring until the sauce begins to thicken. 7. Bring it all together:     Pour the creamy Cajun garlic sauce over the chicken and rice. Garnish with fresh parsley. 🌿

Artist and designer Kleinian creates what he calls “Modern Archaeology”: physical artifacts that imagine how today’s digital culture might survive thousands of years into the future.  He takes real stones and transfers familiar digital images onto them (Artvangarde)smartphone interfaces, Google Maps, Spotify, video games and computer screens. The surfaces are then distressed and sealed, making recent technology look like something excavated from an ancient site.  The contrast is deliberate. Digital technology becomes obsolete incredibly quickly, while stone can survive for millennia. By turning pixels into apparent fossils, Kleinian asks a fascinating question: What would future archaeologists understand about us from the technology we leave behind? #art #artist #avantgarde #design #niche

Viral Pepperoni Pizza Caesar Wrap Recipe 🍕 made this wrap for dinner and my family enjoy it! It’s like having a pizza and a Caesar salad together but without the carbs☺️ Makes 2 wraps Ingredients For the Cheese Wraps * 1½ cups freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella cheese * 14–16 pepperoni slices * sprinkle with oregano and red pepper flakes For the Caesar Salad * 1 head romaine lettuce * ¼ cup crushed croutons * Extra parmesan cheese, for topping For the Caesar Dressing * ¼ cup Best Foods mayonnaise * ¼ cup 0% Greek yogurt * Juice from ½ lemon * 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce * 1½ tsp Dijon mustard * 1 large garlic clove, grated * ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese * ¼–½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Top each with 7–8 pepperoni slices and sprinkle with the oregano and red pepper flakes. 3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy around the edges and golden brown. 4. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. Top with extra parmesan, croutons, and dressing if desired. #dinnerideas #easydinners #caesarsalad #pizza #wrap

Add 1 cup roughly chopped spinach and stir until wilted. 8. Add the cooked tortellini and browned andouille sausage back into the skillet. Toss everything together until the tortellini and sausage are completely coated in the creamy sauce. Cook for another 1–2 minutes. 9. Garnish with red chili flakes and additional Parmesan cheese, if desired. #viralrecipe #tortellini #easydinnerideas #pastarecipe #familymeal

Glossy Honey Garlic Chicken A quick and simply delicious meal to make - juicy seared criss crossed chicken breasts lacquered in a glossy honey garlic sauce. Served over creamy buttery mash and a side of crispy lightly seasoned green beans. Enjoy and follow along for more - @marisakapeal 🙏🏼♥️ Chicken (for 2 large breasts sliced in halves) * 2 large boneless, skinless chicken breasts, sliced in halves and criss crossed with a knife) * 1 tsp salt * ½ tsp black pepper * 1 tsp garlic powder * ½ tsp onion powder * ½ tsp paprika * 1½ tbsp olive oil * 1 tbsp butter Green beans * 2 cups green beans washed and trimmed * Salt and pepper to taste  * Drizzle of olive oil and splash of water  Honey Garlic Sauce * ½ cup honey * 1½ cups chicken broth * 1 tsp dark soy sauce * 2 tbsps low sodium soy sauce  * 6–8 garlic cloves, finely grated or minced * 1 tbsp rice vinegar or apple cider vinegar * ½ tsp black pepper * Pinch red pepper flakes, optional * 1½ tbsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp cold water * 2 tbsp cold butter, for finishing Mash: 6-8 yukon gold potatoes peeled and rinsed  1/4-1/2 cups heavy cream room temperature 1/2 cup unsalted butter, room temperature  Salt and pepper to taste  	1.	Marinate chicken: Slice chicken breasts in half horizontally into 4 thinner cutlets. Lightly score in a crisscross pattern, then coat with olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder and paprika. 	2.	Mashed potatoes: Peel and rinse 6–8 Yukon Gold potatoes. Boil in heavily salted water until fork-tender. Drain and steam-dry for 10 minutes, then mash with ½ cup softened butter, ¼–½ cup heavy cream, and salt and pepper until smooth and creamy. 	3.	Sear chicken: Heat a little olive oil and butter in a skillet over medium-high heat. Sear chicken for 1–2 minutes per side until golden, then remove. Chicken will finish cooking in the sauce. 	4.	Honey garlic sauce: In the same skillet, sauté garlic for 30 seconds. Add chicken broth, honey, soy sauce, dark soy sauce, vinegar and red pepper flakes. Simmer briefly, then gradually stir in cornstarch slurry until slightly thickened. 	5.	Finish chicken: Return chicken to the sauce and simmer, spooning sauce over top, until cooked through (165°F). Remove from heat and swirl in 1–2 tbsp cold butter for a rich, glossy finish. 	6.	Green beans: Sauté green beans with a splash of olive oil and water. Season lightly with salt and pepper and cook for a few minutes until tender-crisp. #honeygarlic #kitchen #cooking #explore #recipe

Creamy Peri Peri Chicken Pasta🍗🧀🍝 Another game changing sheet pan meal prep. This pasta tastes unreal, low effort, easy to make for the week!🤌🏽🔥 Macros Per Serving (8 Total) 592 Calories | 55g Protein | 54g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 8 Servings) Peri Peri Chicken - 1500g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, fat trimmed - 3 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 4 Tsp Oregano - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 4 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Parsley - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Coriander/Cilantro - 1 Lemon Juiced - 8 Tsp Olive Oil - 100g Nando’s Peri Peri Medium Sauce (used to brush over the chicken before cooking) - Avocado Cooking Spray (4 Tsp worth) Creamy Peri Peri Pasta - 200-250g White & Red Onion, chopped - 200-250g Red & Green Bell Pepper, chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Oregano - 2 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 120-150g Tomato Paste - 180g Light Cream Cheese - 400ml Light Evaporated Milk - 150g Peri Peri Medium Sauce - 480g Uncooked Protein Rigatoni Pasta / ~800-900g Cooked Pasta - Fresh Chopped Parsley 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from the chicken thighs. Add seasoning, fresh parsley and coriander, lemon juice, and olive oil. Mix until evenly coated and let marinate if time allows. 2. Line a sheet pan and spread the marinated chicken in a single layer. Brush with peri peri sauce and lightly spray with avocado oil. Bake in a preheated oven at 200C / 400F for 22-25 minutes until golden and juicy. While it cooks, boil the pasta, drain, and set aside. 3. Remove the chicken and keep all the pan juices. Add chopped onion and bell pepper, toss in the juices, spread flat, and roast at 180C / 370F for 15 minutes until soft and lightly charred. 4. While pan is hot, add extra seasoning, tomato paste, cream cheese, milk, peri peri sauce. Mix gently until melted creamy - the residual heat will help emulsify sauce. If needed, return to oven for 5 minutes. 5. Stir in cooked pasta and parsley until coated. Slice peri peri chicken, serve over pasta, and ENJOY! . . . #periperichicken #healthyrecipes #pasta #mealprep #sheetpandinner

WHAT YOU’LL NEED: Honey Garlic Chicken • 800g chicken breast, cubed • 1.5 tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 1 tsp chilli flakes • 1.5 tsp garlic powder • 1.5 tsp onion powder • 1.5 tsp smoked paprika • 2 tsp olive oil • 30g light butter • 2 tsp minced garlic • 30g honey • Handful fresh parsley, chopped Garlic Mac & Cheese • 220g uncooked macaroni • 1 large tbsp minced garlic • 300ml skimmed milk • 160g light cream cheese • 1 tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • 1 tsp smoked paprika • ½ tsp nutmeg • 100g low-fat cheddar cheese HOW TO MAKE IT: 1. Stir until smooth. 7. Lower the heat, add the cheddar and stir until melted. Add the cooked macaroni and give the whole thing another mixy mixy motherfucker! 8. videos.caption: VIRAL BROTHY BEEF BOWLS 🔥 If you love soup recipes, but want something substantial and super filling, these are one of the best easy weeknight meals. It’s so easy to make, so good, and packed with protei and flavor. These are super filling and come in under 500 calories and 35g protein a bowl. One of my favorite protein hacks is using a really good bone broth.That little Kettle & Fire carton has almost 20g of protein on its own, I used up a cup in the broth, and a cup making the rice instead of water to boost the protein + flavor. Here is how I made it: 1️⃣ Start with 1 lb ground beef in a large pan over medium-high heat. Break it apart as it browns, then add 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp red chili flakes, and a generous pinch of salt. Brown it up really well. 2️⃣ For the broth, add 2.5 tbsp red curry paste and 2 minced garlic cloves to a saucepan over medium heat. Stir for 1-2 mins until softened and fragrant. 3️⃣ Pour in 3/4 cup half-and-half (or coconut milk) and 1 cup Kettle & Fire bone broth. Stir everything together until smooth and bring to a gentle simmer. 4️⃣ Season the broth with a generous couple pinches salt, fresh lime juice, and freshly chopped cilantro. Taste and adjust to your liking. You want it creamy, savory, a little spicy, and bright from the lime. 5️⃣ For the quick pickled red onions, super thinly slice 1/2 large red onion and add it to a bowl. Add juice of 1 lemon and sprinkle with sea salt. Mix really well with a fork and let sit 5-10 mins to soften. 6️⃣ Prepare 4 servings rice of choice. I love replacing the water in mine with bone broth for extra flavor + protein. 7️⃣ To assemble, add 3/4 cup cooked rice to a bowl, add 1/4 of the seasoned beef, and ladle 1/4 of the broth over everything. 8️⃣ Top with thinly sliced cucumbers, quick pickled red onions, sesame seeds, Korean chili flakes and plenty of finely chopped fresh cilantro. If you make it, let me know what you think on SHREDHAPPENS! ENJOY! 🙌 #healthyrecipes #healthyfoodshare #goodmoodfood

Chicken Alfredo Tortellini Soup This soup is an easy one-pot dinner that’s perfect for a cozy night!  Ingredients 1 lb chicken breast, cubed 2 tbsp butter 1 sweet onion, diced 3 large carrots, diced Salt and black pepper, to taste 1 tsp garlic powder 1/4 cup all-purpose flour 4 cups chicken stock 1 cup heavy cream or half-and-half 18 oz cheese tortellini 1 (6 oz) bag shredded Parmesan cheese 3 cups fresh spinach 1 tsp crushed red pepper flakes Directions 1. Melt the butter in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the diced onion and carrots. Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and poultry seasoning. Cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables begin to soften. 2. Sprinkle the flour over the vegetables and stir well until everything is evenly coated. Cook for 1–2 minutes. 3. Slowly pour in the chicken stock, stirring continuously to incorporate the flour and create a smooth broth. 4. Add the cubed chicken breast and bring the broth to a boil. Reduce the heat to a simmer and cook until the chicken is cooked through.  5. Stir in the heavy cream or half-and-half, followed by the cheese tortellini. Cook according to the package directions until the tortellini are tender. 6. Reduce the heat to low and gradually stir in the shredded Parmesan cheese until melted and the soup is creamy. 7. Add the fresh spinach and crushed red pepper flakes. Stir for 1–2 minutes, or until the spinach is wilted. 8. Remove from the heat and let the soup sit for about 10–15 minutes before serving. This gives the soup time to thicken and allows all those flavors to come together. Serve warm with extra Parmesan and crushed red pepper on top! Recipe Note The tortellini will continue to soak up the broth as the soup sits, so don't worry if it initially looks a little thinner than you'd like. It will thicken considerably as it rests. If you have leftovers, the tortellini will continue absorbing liquid overnight in the refrigerator. When reheating, simply add a splash of chicken stock, milk, half-and-half, or cream to loosen the soup back up to your desired consistency. #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #soupseason #easydinner #quickrecipes

Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal

VIRAL CARROT WRAPS 🥕 I’ve made a vacation of these with zucchini, pickles, jalapeños, and I had to put a spin on them with carrots. These are probably my second favorite after the zucchini, they come out really good, super pliable/ and they are a touch sweeter which went really well with the toppings I used here. A medium carrot has about 4 net carbs, so this is a great lower carb option if you’re watching carbs. Recipe makes 3-4 wraps Here is how I made it: 1.Preheat oven to 375F.  2.Shred 3 medium carrots into a bowl. Crack in an egg, add 1 cup of shredded pepper jack cheese, toss in 1/2 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tbsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp chipotle pepper (optional), and a small pinch of salt. Mix really well. 3.Grab a cookie sheet, line with parchment paper (important!) and scoop the carrot mixture into circular shapes. You’ll get 3-4 good sized wraps here. 4.Pop it into the oven at 375F for 16-18 minutes. Then remove and let cool for a few minutes while you prep your fillings 5.I spread a base of my homemade guac here. Just mash 2 avocados with the juice of 1 lime, a large handful of freshly chopped cilantro, 1/2 small white onion, a couple pinches of salt, and about a tablespoon of toasted sesame seeds for crunch (optional).  6.I also added some leftover shredded beef (chicken or shrimp work just fine), topped with a tsp of sour cream, some sriracha, and more fresh cilantro. Again, use what you like here! 7.Plate them up and devour. If you make these, be sure to let me know on SHREDHAPPENS - these are a great lowcarb wrap or lower crab bread option, and a great way to sneak in some extra veggies. We were quoted $6,000+ for a patio extension, so my husband and I decided to tackle this backyard renovation ourselves. Here’s what it actually cost: • Skid steer rental for excavation: $350 • Plate compactor rental: $75 • Landscaping fabric: $60 • Truckload of leveling sand: $350 • 350 sq ft of pavers (delivered): $935 • Polymeric sand for the paver joints: $90 • Edge restraints (that I hated): $130 • Miscellaneous DIY tools + concrete blade: $100 Total DIY patio cost: $2,090. After laying the pavers, we made all the edge cuts with an angle grinder and somehow managed to get the transition to our existing patio looking pretty dang professional. I even ditched the border bricks I bought and “shopped” my own backyard for free landscaping rocks instead. 😂 This DIY backyard makeover ended up being cheaper than the poured concrete quotes we received, but I love that paver patios add so much more character, texture, and curb appeal. If you’ve been debating a DIY patio installation, consider this your sign that it might be more achievable than you think. Durante mucho tiempo hizo millones con su negocio, pero el huracán destruyó su restaurante en 2005. La verdad es que sus tigres jamás desaparecieron, sino que fueron enviados a diferentes zoológicos y santuarios (con información confirmada por organizaciones ambientales). Tampoco existió el llamado santuario de Pepe: en sus propios videos pueden comprobar que en realidad operaba como un terreno con jaulas para resguardar a sus felinos. This isn't a scene from a film. This is a heartbreaking reality that still exists in parts of Nepal. For some women and girls, getting their period means being sent away from their own home to spend the night in a small shed, away from their families. They are left to face cold nights, fear, loneliness, and the danger of snakes, insects, and wild animals—all because of a natural biological process. Menstruation should never be a reason for exclusion or shame. Take a moment and ask yourself: If it were someone you love—your daughter, your sister, your wife, or your mother—would you accept this as "tradition"? Some customs deserve to be questioned, especially when they put lives and dignity at risk. Every woman deserves to feel safe, respected, and valued, no matter what day of the month it is. Let's raise awareness, start conversations, and stand together to end harmful practices like this. EASY RECIPE BELOW👇😋 𝐂𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐦𝐲 𝐒𝐦𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐝 𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐧 & 𝐑𝐢𝐜𝐞  …this one is PURE comfort food & so easy 🥹🍗🍚 the sauce is rich, herby, a little spice, and so good poured over fluffy rice!!🤍✨ ⸻ 𝐈𝐧𝐠𝐫𝐞𝐝𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐬: 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐧: • 2 lbs chicken thighs or breasts • 1 tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp paprika • 1 tsp dried thyme • 1 tsp dried parsley • 2 tbsp olive oil 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐒𝐚𝐮𝐜𝐞: • 2 tbsp butter • 1 small onion, diced • 3 cloves garlic, minced • 2 cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1 tsp dried thyme • 1 tsp dried parsley • ½ tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • ½ tsp red pepper flakes • 1 tsp cornstarch + 1 tbsp water (optional to make it thicker) 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐑𝐢𝐜𝐞: • 1½ cups long-grain white rice • 3 cups water or chicken broth ⸻  𝐈𝐧𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬:  1. Season your chicken with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, thyme, and parsley. 2. Heat olive oil in a skillet and sear chicken 4–5 minutes per side until golden. Remove it and set aside with foil over it. 3. In the same pan, add olive oil. Add your diced onion and sauté about 3 minutes until soft. Keep stirring so it doesn’t burn. Then add butter & garlic and cook 30 seconds. 4. Pour in chicken broth to deglaze the pan. Stir in heavy cream, thyme, parsley, salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes. Simmer about 5 minutes. (Add cornstarch slurry if you want it thicker.) 5. Return chicken to the sauce. Cover and simmer on low 10–15 minutes until fully cooked and tender. 6. Cook rice separately… bring liquid to a boil, add rinsed rice, cover and cook about 15 minutes. Let sit 5 minutes, then fluff. 7. Serve chicken over rice and spoon extra creamy sauce on top 🤍 #easydinner #dinnerinspo #easyrecipes #chickenandrice #chickenrecipes

Street Corn Chicken Bowls: Gut Healthy Edition 🌽 @Nature Made  Juicy spiced chicken, the most addictive green sauce you've ever made, and a zesty street corn salad. High protein, gut-healthy and paired with my daily Nature Made Probiotic + Prebiotic Fiber Gummies… weeknight approved 🫡 #partner For the Chicken: -1.5 lbs (680g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs -Seasoning: 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp oregano, 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -3 tbsp olive oil -6 garlic cloves, minced -1 lime, juiced For the Street Corn: -30 oz (850 g) corn kernels (or 4 cobs) -⅓ cup red onion, finely diced -1 fresh jalapeno, diced (deseeded) -½ avocado, cubed -¼ cup fresh cilantro, chopped -⅓ cup cotija cheese (or feta), crumbled -Seasonings: 2 tsp chile lime, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -¼ cup greek yogurt -¼ cup mayonnaise -½ lime, juiced For the Aji Verde: -½ cup greek yogurt -½ cup mayonnaise  -1 small jalapeño, deseeded -1 1/2 cups cilantro, leaves and stems -4 to 5 garlic cloves -2 tsp black pepper -1 tsp salt -Juice of 1 lime Instructions: 1. Macros Per Serving (10 Total) 596 Calories | 54g Protein | 51g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Servings) Honey Garlic Parmesan Chicken •Marinade - 1500g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, cubed - 3 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 130g Grated Parmigiano Reggiano - 45g Honey - 8 Tsp / 40g Olive Oil •After Cooking - Extra 15g Honey - Extra 20g Grated Parmesan - Parsley for garnish Crispy Roasted Potatoes - 1800g Raw White/Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 4 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - Olive Oil Cooking Spray, 5 seconds spray Creamy Parmesan Tuscan Sauce •Blender - 700g Fat Free Cottage Cheese - 250g Skimmed Milk - 250g Light Evaporated Milk •Pan - 30g Light Butter - 200g White Onion, finely chopped - 45g Garlic, finely chopped - 200g Sundried Tomatoes, drained & chopped - Handful Fresh Basil Leaves, roughly chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 100g Grated Parmesan - 20g Parmesan Rind Chunks Cooking Instructions 1. Cube chicken thighs. Add seasonings, Parmesan, honey and olive oil. Mix well and set aside. Prepare cream sauce. 2. Cube potatoes and add to a lined sheet pan. Finish with honey and Parmesan. 6. Add crispy potatoes to the cream sauce and gently fold until well coated. Honey Crispy Chicken Ingredients 	•	2 lbs chicken breasts, cubed 	•	2 eggs, beaten 	•	1 ½ cups cornstarch 	•	2 Tbsp soy sauce 	•	½ tsp black pepper 	•	¼ cup brown sugar 	•	¾ cup butter 	•	3–4 cloves garlic, minced 	•	¼ tsp red pepper flakes 	•	¼ cup soy sauce 	•	½ cup honey 	•	1 Tbsp water 	•	1 Tbsp cornstarch (for slurry) 	•	Vegetable oil, for frying 	•	Steamed white rice, for serving ⸻ Instructions 	1.	Prepare the Chicken: 	•	In a bowl, mix chicken cubes with eggs, 2 Tbsp soy sauce, and black pepper. 	•	Add cornstarch and toss until chicken is well coated. 	2.	Fry the Chicken: 	•	Heat vegetable oil in a deep skillet or wok over medium-high heat. 	•	Fry chicken in batches for 5–7 minutes, until golden brown and cooked through. 	•	Remove and drain on paper towels. 	3.	Make the Honey Sauce: 	•	In a saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter. 	•	Add garlic and red pepper flakes, sauté until fragrant. 	•	Stir in brown sugar, ¼ cup soy sauce, and honey. Bring to a gentle boil. 	•	Mix 1 Tbsp water with 1 Tbsp cornstarch in a small bowl to make a slurry. Whisk into the sauce and cook for 2–3 minutes until thickened. 	4.	Combine & Serve: 	•	Add fried chicken to the sauce and toss until coated evenly. 	•	Serve hot over a bed of steamed white rice. #chicken #fyp #fypシ #viral #recipe

🌈 SUPER SIMPLE TASTE-SAFE KINETIC SAND 🌈 If you’re looking for kid safe kinetic sand - this is it! It might not have the silicone binder that store bought has which gives a stretchy effect, but it’s made with 5 simple ingredients, that still gives it the ability to be squished and moulded while holding its shape and it crumbles like sand. It’s fun, cheap, and so easy to whip up… plus your little ones will love it! INGREDIENTS: 1 cup baking soda 1/2 cup sugar 3/4 cup cornflour  1 Tbsp cream of tartar 1/4 cup of water 1 tsp food colouring (optional) HOW TO: 1. Add the baking soda, sugar, cornflour, and cream of tartar to a large bowl, and stir  everything together. 2. In a small cup, mix your food colouring & water (if you’re using food colouring). 3. Add 2 Tbsp of the water into the dry mix and whisk together. If its still too powdery and doesn’t clump in your hands, add 1 Tbsp more of the water, and stir again. Repeat up to the full 1/4 cup of water, squishing with your hands to mix it in and get the right texture (note if you get heavy handed with the water, counterbalance it by adding equal parts cornflour & sugar, 1 Tbsp of each at a time) 4. Enjoy! NOTES: 🫙 Store in an airtight container in the fridge for 4–6 weeks. If it dries out a little, add 1–2 tsp of water and mix it through with your hands. 🌈  you can make the colour brighter by adding a few extra drops into the water at the beginning. 👶 whilst this recipe is taste-safe, make sure to supervise little ones closely as it’s not for eating by the handful.  . . . . . #kineticsand #toddler #kidsactivities #sensoryplay #playtolearn

✨ Cheesy Meat-Stuffed Breakfast Biscuits ✨ A delicious, flaky, and cheese-packed comfort food recipe featuring golden-brown biscuits stuffed with savory ground meat and melted cheese. 🍴 Ingredients: - 1 package refrigerated biscuit dough or homemade biscuit dough - 1 lb ground beef or sausage, cooked and seasoned - 1.5 cups shredded cheddar cheese - 2 tbsp melted butter - 1 tsp garlic powder - Fresh parsley, finely chopped for garnish - Salt and freshly cracked black pepper to taste 👩🏽‍🍳 Instructions: 1. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. 2. Cook the ground meat in a skillet with salt, pepper, and garlic powder until fully browned, then drain excess fat. 3. Separate the biscuit dough, flatten each piece slightly, and place a spoonful of cooked meat and a generous amount of shredded cheese in the center. 4. Fold the dough securely around the filling to form stuffed biscuit balls or rounds, pinching the edges to seal. 5. Arrange the stuffed biscuits on the prepared baking sheet. 6. Brush the tops with melted butter and sprinkle a little extra cheese or parsley on top. 7. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 to 18 minutes until the biscuits are golden brown and cooked through. 8. Remove from the oven, let cool slightly, and serve warm. 📝 Notes: These flaky, cheese-stuffed biscuits make the ultimate grab-and-go breakfast, packed with rich flavor in every single bite. #BreakfastBiscuits #StuffedBiscuits #CheeseLovers #ComfortFood #SavoryBaking

Grilled Teriyaki Chicken 🔥🍗 Cook Like an Asian Ep 1: Grilled Teriyaki Chicken. Welcome to my series, where I teach you easy Asian recipes so good, your friends will think you’re Asian. 🤙🏽 Sweet, savory, garlicky chicken thighs grilled over charcoal for smoky flavor and a beautiful char. This is the series where I bring the recipes, and you take the credit. 🙌🏽 Ingredients: 2 lb boneless chicken thighs ½ cup shoyu (soy sauce) ½ cup brown sugar 5 garlic cloves, crushed 1 tbsp crushed ginger 1 tbsp sesame oil 1 tbsp rice vinegar 1 tsp mirin Instructions: 1. Mix the shoyu, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, rice vinegar, and mirin until combined. 2. Reserve ¼ cup of marinade BEFORE adding the raw chicken. Refrigerate separately for brushing during the cook. 3. Place chicken in a zip-top bag and pour in the remaining marinade. Seal, massage to coat, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or overnight. 4. Fire up your charcoal grill. Once the coals are hot, keep one side cooler so you can move the chicken if it browns too quickly.  5. Remove chicken from the bag and discard the used marinade. Grill over the hot coals, flipping and brushing both sides with the reserved marinade to build that beautiful char. 6. Move to the cooler side as needed to prevent burning, and cook until the thickest part reaches 165°F. 7. Rest for 5 minutes, then slice and serve with hot rice! 🍚 Don’t let these ingredients intimidate you because I got all of them from my local Walmart! #teriyakichicken #asianfood #easyrecipe

You already know this Cowboy Mashed Potato Casserole is gonna be GOOD! 🤠 To get the recipe, click the link in @allrecipes bio or continue reading! ⬇️ Ingredients: cooking spray 6 strips bacon 2 pounds baking potatoes, peeled and chopped 1 (5 ounce) can evaporated milk or whole milk 2 tablespoons butter 1 1/2 teaspoons salt, divided 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper, divided 1 pound ground beef 1 cup chopped onion 1 green bell pepper, chopped 1 cup frozen whole kernel corn 2 cloves garlic, minced 1 1/2 teaspoons smoked paprika 1/4 cup barbecue sauce 1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard 1/2 cup shredded Cheddar or pepper Jack cheese 1/4 cup canned French fried onions 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh parsley Directions: Gather all ingredients. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F. Grease a 2-quart baking dish with cooking spray. Place dish on a baking sheet. Cook bacon in a large skillet over medium, turning occasionally, until crisp, about 10 minutes. Place bacon on a paper towel to drain. Drain all but 1 Tbsp of bacon fat in the skillet. Chop bacon when cool enough to handle. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add potatoes and return to a boil. Cook, covered, until potatoes are fork tender, 15-20 minutes. Drain potatoes. Return potatoes back to the pot along with evaporated milk, butter, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp pepper. Mash potatoes with a potato masher until smooth. Stir 1/4 c chopped bacon into mashed potatoes. Add ground beef, onion, and bell pepper to the skillet with reserved bacon fat. Cook over medium until meat is browned and cooked through, stirring occasionally, 8-10 minutes. Add corn kernels, garlic, and paprika to the skillet. Cook and stir for 1 minute. Stir in barbecue sauce, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, remaining 1 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp pepper. Spread ground beef mixture in prepared baking dish. Spread potatoes evenly over beef. Sprinkle with cheese, remaining bacon, and French fried onions. Bake until bubbly and cheese is melted, 20-25 minutes. Garnish with parsley. 👨‍🍳: Nicole McLaughlin #cowboycasserole #mashedpotatoes #easydinners #dinnerideas

Ingredients: * Chicken legs * Olive oil * Garlic powder * Onion powder * Paprika * Seasoning salt * Black pepper * Italian seasoning * 1 orange bell pepper, sliced * 1 green bell pepper, sliced * 1 onion, sliced * 2 cans cream of mushroom soup * ½–1 cup chicken broth * Jasmine rice * French-style green beans * Buttermilk biscuits * Honey for glazing Instructions: 1. 🧀 Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Garlic Potatoes & Green Beans 🍗🥔 This Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Garlic Potatoes & Green Beans is an easy sheet-pan dinner packed with bold flavor. Juicy oven-roasted chicken is coated in a crispy Parmesan crust, while buttery garlic potatoes and tender green beans roast alongside for a complete, satisfying family meal with minimal cleanup. Ingredients For the Chicken • 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts • 2 tbsp olive oil • ¾ cup grated Parmesan cheese • ½ cup panko breadcrumbs • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp Italian seasoning • ½ tsp smoked paprika • ¾ tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper For the Potatoes • 1½ lbs baby Yukon Gold potatoes, halved • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp melted butter • 1 tsp garlic powder • ½ tsp paprika • Salt and black pepper, to taste For the Green Beans • 12 oz fresh green beans, trimmed • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tbsp melted butter • Salt and black pepper, to taste For Garnish • 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley • Lemon wedges Instructions 1. Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Lightly grease a large sheet pan or line it with parchment paper. 2. Toss the potatoes with olive oil, melted butter, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Spread them evenly on one side of the pan and roast for 15 minutes. 3. In a shallow bowl, combine the Parmesan cheese, panko breadcrumbs, garlic powder, Italian seasoning, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. 4. Brush both sides of the chicken breasts with olive oil, then press them firmly into the Parmesan mixture until well coated. 5. Remove the sheet pan from the oven and move the potatoes to one side. Arrange the coated chicken in the center. 6. Toss the green beans with olive oil, melted butter, minced garlic, salt, and pepper, then place them beside the chicken. 7. Bake for 20–25 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C) and the potatoes are fork-tender. 8. Switch the oven to broil and cook for 2–3 minutes until the Parmesan crust is extra crispy and golden. 9. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve with lemon wedges. Serving Suggestions Serve with Caesar salad, garlic bread, roasted carrots, steamed broccoli, or creamy ranch dipping sauce for a complete restaurant-style dinner. Storage Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days. Reheat in the oven or air fryer to keep the chicken crispy. Prep Time: 15 minutes Cook Time: 40 minutes Total Time: 55 minutes Servings: 4 Calories: Approximately 610 per serving #ParmesanChicken #SheetPanDinner #EasyDinner #ComfortFood #FamilyMeals

Save this recipe in @myrecipes so it's ready when you are. Ingredients: 2 cups white rice 1 (10.5-ounces) can condensed French onion soup 2 (10.5 ounce) cans condensed beef consomme 8 ounces baby portobello mushrooms, roughly chopped 1 cup grated Pecorino Romano or Parmesan cheese, divided 1 stick butter, cut into 8 pieces 2 pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs 1 1/4 teaspoons kosher salt 3/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 1 teaspoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon onion powder 1 teaspoon paprika 1 tablespoon chopped parsley (optional) Directions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Stir rice, French onion soup, beef consomme, and portobello mushrooms together in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with 3/4 cup of the cheese and add butter pieces on top. Season chicken evenly with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika and place on top of cheese and butter. Top with remaining cheese and cover dish with foil. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake until top is golden brown, liquid has been absorbed into the rice, and chicken is cooked through, about 20 more minutes. Sprinkle with fresh parsley if desired. Inspiration: @melissajorealrecipes 🧑‍🍳: @nicolemcmom #easydinners #dinnerideas #butter #chicken #chickenandrice

My one pan, dump & bake chicken broccoli orzo casserole is the easiest weeknight dinner. Tender chicken, orzo pasta, and broccoli bake together in one dish with no boiling, no sautéing, no extra dishes. Save this chicken broccoli orzo bake for busy nights when you want comfort food without the work! 🙃🧀🥦🍗 #onepanmeals #dumpandbake #busymommeals #easyrecipes #thecookingmawma INGREDIENTS: -serves 4-6- 	•	1.5 cups chicken broth 	•	1-10.5oz can cream of chicken soup 	•	1tbsp chicken bouillon powder 	•	1/2tsp parsley flakes 	•	1/4tsp oregano 	•	1/4tsp rosemary 	•	1/4tsp thyme 	•	1/4tsp garlic powder 	•	1/2tsp onion powder 	•	1 cup broccoli florets (fresh or frozen) 	•	1 cup cooked, shredded chicken (I used rotisserie) 	•	1/2 box (8oz) uncooked orzo pasta 	•	1 cup cheddar cheese INSTRUCTIONS: 	1.	Preheat oven to 425 degrees F. Grease an 8x10 baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. 	2.	Add chicken broth, can of soup and all spices and whisk together. Stir in broccoli, cooked chicken and uncooked orzo. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 30 minutes. 	3.	Uncover after 30 minutes and stir gently with a fork. Sprinkle cheese on top and bake uncovered for another 5 minutes. Turn on the broiler for another 2 minutes to create a crispy, brown topping. Enjoy!

Garlic parmesan chicken tenders Ingredients  For the chicken marinade : 2 lb boneless chicken breast, cut into strips and pounded  3 cups buttermilk  Salt to taste 1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tsp onion powder  1 tsp mustard powder  1 tbsp paprika powder  1/2 tsp black pepper powder  1 tbsp white vinegar  Oil for deep frying  For the dry batter  2 cups all purpose flour  3/4 cup corn starch  2 tsp baking powder  Salt to taste 1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tsp onion powder  1 tbsp paprika powder  1/2 tsp black pepper powder  For the garlic parmesan glaze 4 tbsp butter 1 tbsp fresh garlic, finely chopped  1 teaspoon red chili flakes Or 1 red chili , chopped  1 tbsp parsley, chopped  1/3 cup Parmesan cheese, fresh grated  1/2 cups mayonnaise  1 tsp garlic powder  1/2 tsp black pepper  Salt to taste 1 tbsp lemon juice  For the spicy garlic parmesan sauce  1/3 cup mayonnaise  1/4 cup garlic parmesan glaze 2 tbsp hot sauce  Method  Method Mix buttermilk, seasonings, and vinegar. Add chicken, cover, and refrigerate for 2–4 hours. Combine all dry batter ingredients. Let excess marinade drip off chicken, then dredge in the flour mixture, pressing firmly. For a craggy coating, rub 2–3 tbsp marinade into the flour to create small clumps. For extra crunch, dip chicken back into marinade and dredge again. Heat oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry in batches for 4–6 minutes until golden and cooked through (165°F/74°C internally). Transfer to a wire rack. For the glaze, melt butter over medium-low heat. Add garlic and cook for 30–60 seconds. Add chili and cook briefly. Remove from heat, stir in parsley and Parmesan, and cool slightly. Whisk in mayonnaise, garlic powder, pepper, lemon juice, and salt until creamy. Mix mayonnaise,1/4 cup glaze, and hot sauce to make the spicy dip. Toss hot tenders in just enough glaze to coat. Garnish with Parmesan and parsley. Serve immediately with the spicy garlic Parmesan sauce #recipe #garlicparmesan #tenders

This recipe is guaranteed to become your new holiday tradition. 🍠🧡 Yummy Sweet Potato Casserole combines a smooth, buttery filling with a crisp brown sugar-pecan topping. 😋 You can also prep it ahead for an easy, crowd-pleasing side dish. 🙌 Get the full recipe details below or at the link in our bio! ⬆️ 🍠 Sweet Potatoes: 4 cups peeled, cubed sweet potatoes 2 large eggs, beaten 1/2cup white sugar 1/2 cup milk 4 tablespoons butter, softened 1/2teaspoon vanilla extract 1/2teaspoon salt ⭐ Pecan Topping: 1/2 cup packed brown sugar 1/3 cup all-purpose flour 3 tablespoons butter, softened 1/2 cup chopped pecans Directions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C). Put sweet potatoes in a medium saucepan; cover with water. Cook over medium-high heat until tender and easily pierced with a fork, 10 to 15 minutes. Drain and transfer to a large bowl. Mash sweet potatoes with a fork. Add eggs; mix until well combined. Add sugar, milk, butter, vanilla extract, and salt; mix until smooth. Transfer to a 9x13-inch baking dish. Mix brown sugar and flour together in a medium bowl. Cut in butter with a pastry cutter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs; don’t overmix. Stir in pecans. Sprinkle topping over sweet potato mixture. Bake in the preheated oven until topping is lightly browned, about 30 minutes. 🎥: Nicole @nicolesperfectbite #sweetpotato #pecan #casserole #thanksgiving #cooking #holidays

This piece of functional art is here to remind you that no matter how gloopy and messy life gets, there is always love and joy bursting through. 🌈💗 I am so excited to finally start sharing the first pieces from my 2026 collection! The first half of this year has been full of learning, experimenting, and pushing my work in new directions. It has also been one of the heaviest seasons of my life. While making this collection, I found myself returning again and again to the same idea: choosing hope. This piece feels like a little celebration of that. A reminder that even when things feel overwhelming, beautiful things can still emerge from the mess. Thankfully, the scary chapter my chosen family has been living through is coming to a very happy ending, and I am sitting in deep gratitude for that. Not everyone gets that outcome, and I don’t take it for granted for a second. Recipe below 👇 PROTEIN BBQ CHICKEN THIGHS Makes 12 Servings Per Serving: 517 Calories | 75g Protein | $2.67 Ingredients Chicken Thighs   8 lbs | 3628g Low Sugar BBQ Sauce   1 bottle | 510g Lemon Juice   2 tbsp | 30g (1 lemon) Salt, pepper, chili powder, garlic powder Directions 1. Trim any excess fat from the chicken thighs and pat them dry with paper towels. 2. In a large bowl, toss the chicken thighs with lemon juice, salt, pepper, chili powder, and garlic powder until evenly coated. 3. Preheat your grill to medium-high heat, approximately 400°F (205°C). 4. Place the chicken thighs on the grill and cook for 5-7 minutes per side, or until the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C). 5. During the last 2 minutes of cooking, brush the low-sugar BBQ sauce generously over both sides of the chicken to caramelize. 6. Remove from the grill and let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before serving or slicing for meal prep. #highprotein #fyp #mealprep #nutrition #chickenthighs
